symptom: in a Protected (add-on) module, a navigation home page / menu item / call microflow / parameter type pointing at a Hidden element, and an `export level api` microflow whose parameter or return type is a Hidden entity of that module, passed check -p --references and exec, then mxbuild refused with CE1406 "... because project level documents|app modules cannot reference hidden elements in add-on modules" and CE5400 "The export level of entity 'M.E' should be 'Usable' because parameter 'p' exposes it"; describe and show modules never said the module was Protected
cause: nothing read Projects$ModuleSettings.ExportLevel for validation, and entityFromGen dropped the entity's ExportLevel, so no check could know what is Hidden
insight: Measure with mxbuild before trusting the issue's expectation: a PAGE in a Protected module is refused even with ExportLevel API stored on it (11.13.0 and 11.14.0, navigation and show-page alike), so `export level api` on pages would not have helped — an API microflow in the module that shows the page is the measured way in. CE1406 masks CE5400 (mxbuild reports the CE5400 only once the CE1406 is gone), so a one-shot mx check undercounts; measure each rule in its own copy. A module can be made Protected for measurement with UpdateModuleSettings (ExportLevel 'Protected') — no Studio Pro needed; the scratch helper set it and element ExportLevels by raw BSON
